Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: In the final step (Step 3), the Planner incorrectly interpreted the search results. The search results from Britannica and Wikipedia clearly stated that the Yongle Emperor was born in "Yingtian [now Nanjing]" (as seen in the text "Yongle (born May 2, 1360, Yingtian [now Nanjing], Jiangsu province...)" and "Yingtian [Nanjing], China"). However, the Planner hallucinated that Yingtian corresponds to "Shangqiu, Henan Province," which is factually incorrect. Yingtian is the historical name for Nanjing. This error led to the wrong final answer (Shangqiu instead of Nanjing).
